prompts: Create an animation sprite sheet, FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS, eight frames, one complete RUN CYCLE ONLY. Reference1 shows exact adult Tifa character design, reference2 exact running lean/rendering. Transparent background, no text/effects. Constant scale, pelvis center and head height, side profile facing RIGHT; white tank, black skirt/shorts/stockings, red gloves/boots. Critical: advancing time through a run, not variants of a single stride. Near leg and far leg ALTERNATE. Top row frames1-4: 1 near boot on ground AHEAD, far leg behind; 2 near knee bent supporting under hip, far knee sweeping forward; 3 near boot pushes behind, far knee now FORWARD at waist level; 4 airborne, far boot reaches FORWARD to land, near boot curled BACK near butt. Bottom row frames5-8: 5 far boot on ground AHEAD, near leg behind; 6 far knee bent supporting under hip, near knee sweeping forward; 7 far boot pushes behind, near knee FORWARD at waist level; 8 airborne, near boot reaches FORWARD to land, far boot curled BACK near butt, returns to frame1. Arms counter swing: near arm ahead when near leg behind, near arm behind when near leg ahead. Every full body separated in its own equal cell, uniform head/torso dimensions and consistent hair rendering. Actual changing leg support and passing, no repeated crouched flying pose. Source neutral stance remains unchanged in game.

Edit the provided 4-column 2-row running sprite sheet ONLY to fix clipping/spacing. Preserve all eight poses, character identity, clothing, coloring and anatomy. Give EVERY full character a separate equal square cell with 20 percent TRANSPARENT PADDING on every side. All eight boots and hair tips FULLY inside their own cells; no part touches canvas/cell edges. Restore the clipped toes of first column and fourth column. SAME uniform character scale across all eight cells. Exactly 4 columns and 2 rows, 8 characters. NO white trails or marks behind feet, no text, no background; genuine transparent RGBA. This is an isolated full-body sprite sheet for production; overlapping or clipped characters are unusable.
